title: An Asynchronous multi-rate Taylor method for Delay Differential Equations
summary: The numerical simulation of high-dimensional, multi-rate Delay Differential Equations (DDEs) is fundamentally bottlenecked by synchronous time-stepping and the dynamic memory allocation required for continuous history tracking. In this paper, we introduce the Asynchronous Adaptive Taylor Solver (AATS), an event-driven integration framework designed to overcome these high-performance computing limitations.
